purpose: Declare one test per AC of US-19201 (FBS-218) driving rcf verify run --mode deterministic and rcf define update/validate through bin/rcf.js, so the FBS-218 Define round turns each declaration into a red test against the probe catalog behaviour.
title: Per-AC probe catalog resolved by deterministic verify: AC-level and catalog probes, pass/fail/critiqueOnly/skipped results, parityEnv scoping, probe schema refusal, no spawn

testCases.description: rcf verify run --url <target> --fbs <fbs-id> --mode deterministic with an AC probe { path: "/health", expectStatus: 200 } served 200 exits 0; report records the AC "pass" with observed status and elapsed time and runStats.counts.verified incremented
testCases.testPointer: test/verify/probe-catalog.test.js::AC-19201-1: rcf verify run --url <target> --fbs <fbs-id> --mode deterministic with an AC probe { path: "/health", expectStatus: 200 } served 200 exits 0; report records the AC "pass" with observed status and elapsed time and runStats.counts.verified incremented

testCases.description: rcf verify run --mode deterministic with a probe expecting 200 and body "ready" against a body without "ready" exits 4; report records the AC "fail" naming the failed expectation and observed value, runStats.counts.failed at least 1
testCases.testPointer: test/verify/probe-catalog.test.js::AC-19201-2: rcf verify run --mode deterministic with a probe expecting 200 and body "ready" against a body without "ready" exits 4; report records the AC "fail" naming the failed expectation and observed value, runStats.counts.failed at least 1

testCases.description: rcf verify run --mode deterministic on an AC with no probe and no catalog entry exits 4 recording "critiqueOnly" counted in runStats.counts.critiqueOnly, verdict not PASS; an unreachable probe path is recorded "skipped" with the error kind, never "pass"
testCases.testPointer: test/verify/probe-catalog.test.js::AC-19201-3: rcf verify run --mode deterministic on an AC with no probe and no catalog entry exits 4 recording "critiqueOnly" counted in runStats.counts.critiqueOnly, verdict not PASS; an unreachable probe path is recorded "skipped" with the error kind, never "pass"

testCases.description: rcf verify run --mode deterministic uses the AC-level probe over rcf/verify-catalog.json with evidence source "ac", a catalog-only probe with source "catalog"; a catalog key naming no AC makes rcf define validate exit 3
testCases.testPointer: test/verify/probe-catalog.test.js::AC-19201-4: rcf verify run --mode deterministic uses the AC-level probe over rcf/verify-catalog.json with evidence source "ac", a catalog-only probe with source "catalog"; a catalog key naming no AC makes rcf define validate exit 3

testCases.description: rcf verify run --mode deterministic --parity-env staging resolves a probe with parityEnv "staging"; with --parity-env production the same probe is recorded "skipped" with reason "parityEnv mismatch"
testCases.testPointer: test/verify/probe-catalog.test.js::AC-19201-5: rcf verify run --mode deterministic --parity-env staging resolves a probe with parityEnv "staging"; with --parity-env production the same probe is recorded "skipped" with reason "parityEnv mismatch"

testCases.description: rcf define update <us-id> --ac <ac-id> --probe {"path":"/","expectStatus":200} stores the probe and rcf define validate exits 0; an unknown probe key or a non-integer expectStatus is refused with exit 3 naming the key
testCases.testPointer: test/verify/probe-catalog.test.js::AC-19201-6: rcf define update <us-id> --ac <ac-id> --probe {"path":"/","expectStatus":200} stores the probe and rcf define validate exits 0; an unknown probe key or a non-integer expectStatus is refused with exit 3 naming the key

testCases.description: rcf verify run --mode deterministic on a chain with no in-scope probe exits 4 with runStats.counts.verified 0, never records "pass" for an AC without a probe and spawns no child process
testCases.testPointer: test/verify/probe-catalog.test.js::AC-19201-7: rcf verify run --mode deterministic on a chain with no in-scope probe exits 4 with runStats.counts.verified 0, never records "pass" for an AC without a probe and spawns no child process

testCases.description: rcf verify run --mode deterministic records an assertion-free probe (catalog { path: "/" } or AC-level) as "fail" with evidence naming the missing assertion, counts it under runStats.counts.failed never verified, and exits 4
testCases.testPointer: test/verify/probe-catalog.test.js::AC-19201-8: rcf verify run --mode deterministic records an assertion-free probe (catalog { path: "/" } or AC-level) as "fail" with evidence naming the missing assertion, counts it under runStats.counts.failed never verified, and exits 4

testCases.description: rcf define validate exits 3 naming the key for an rcf/verify-catalog.json probe with no assertion, and exits 3 when catalogVersion is missing or not 1
testCases.testPointer: test/verify/probe-catalog.test.js::AC-19201-8: rcf define validate exits 3 naming the key for an rcf/verify-catalog.json probe with no assertion, and exits 3 when catalogVersion is missing or not 1

testCases.description: rcf verify run --mode deterministic records a catalog probe with an empty or malformed assertion (expectBody {}, selector "", expectBody { contains: "" }, expectHeader match "", expectStatus "200") as "fail" with evidence naming the field, counts it under runStats.counts.failed never verified, and exits 4
testCases.testPointer: test/verify/probe-catalog.test.js::AC-19201-8: rcf verify run --mode deterministic records a catalog probe with an empty or malformed assertion (expectBody {}, selector "", expectBody { contains: "" }, expectHeader match "", expectStatus "200") as "fail" with evidence naming the field, counts it under runStats.counts.failed never verified, and exits 4

testCases.description: rcf define validate exits 3 naming the key and the field for an rcf/verify-catalog.json probe with an empty or malformed assertion

testCases.description: an AC-level probe with an empty assertion (expectBody {}, selector "") is refused with exit 3 naming the field, by rcf define update --probe and by rcf verify run --mode deterministic on a tree that already carries one

testCases.description: rcf define validate exits 3 naming the key and the field for an rcf/verify-catalog.json probe with a whitespace-only assertion string (contains, matches, header name, header match, selector)
